subject: End-of-term financial close: usage adjustment, withholding docs & escrow next steps
body:
--- Message 1: Jordan Price to Redwood billing team (external) ---
From: Jordan Price <accounts-payable@greenleaf.health>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
Cc: Greenleaf Procurement <procure@greenleaf.health>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final billing items before renewal effective 2027-04-30

Maya,

We pulled together Greenleaf's account close items for the end of our current term (ends 2027-04-30). Before we issue final payment we need: 
- Final invoice showing usage true-up and credit application (line-level)
- Withholding tax calculation for payments to a US vendor (our AP team applies 10% WHT unless we get a certificate)
- VAT evidence for EU-hosted usage (if any) — but looks like most usage for us is US.
- Confirmation of escrow or payment hold instructions for disputed items (we have one disputed integration charge of ~$4,200).

Can you confirm when Redwood can provide the final invoice + supporting schedule and whether you can provide a withholding certificate or direction on gross-up? We prefer to complete payment within 10 business days of receiving the final packet.

Thanks,
Jordan Price
Accounts Payable | Greenleaf Health
accounts-payable@greenleaf.health

--- Message 2: Maya Srinivasan (internal) reply to Jordan + cc finance ---
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <accounts-payable@greenleaf.health>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final billing items before renewal effective 2027-04-30

Hi Jordan — thanks for laying this out. We can absolutely get a final packet together this week. Plan below: 

1) Final invoice PDF (line-level): I will attach the invoice that nets the credits you have in your account and includes a usage true-up schedule. Timeline: draft to you by EOD 2027-04-08.
2) Withholding: Redwood can provide the WHT calculation schedule in Excel and the standard withholding-certificate template we would need to complete on our side. If Greenleaf can share the local tax form (or completed certificate) we will confirm whether gross-up is required.
3) Dispute escrow: For the $4,200 integration item, propose we instruct your AP to hold that specific line in escrow pending a 10-business-day technical review. If Greenleaf prefers Redwood to place funds into a short-term escrow account, finance (Vivek) can provide wiring/escrow instructions.
4) Evidence links: I will upload the supporting S3/Drive folder with call detail and prompt-level usage breakdown.

Attachments: RW_Final_Invoice_2027-04-01.pdf (draft), WHT_Calculation_Greenleaf.xlsx, Withholding-Certificate-Template.pdf (blank).

Laura / Vivek — looping you both in to confirm escrow routing and whether we should propose a gross-up option or accept withholding and net the final payment. Also advise if you want legal to sign the certificate or have Treasury handle.

Jordan — if that timeline works we will proceed and send the DocuSign for any payment-terms amendment.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Lead, Renewals | Redwood Inference
---

--- Message 3: Internal coordination (Laura to Maya + Vivek) ---
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final billing items before renewal effective 2027-04-30

Thanks — quick guidance: 
- Finance prefers Redwood not to gross-up. Accept the withholding and reflect it as a line deduction on the final invoice. Add a short memo in the packet indicating the withheld amount and reference to the certificate to be provided.
- For escrow: we can provide an internal escrow routing for up to 30 days. Vivek, please confirm bank/wire details and whether we need a counterparty escrow agreement. If so, legal (cc'd manually if needed) will provide a one-page holdback addendum.
- Please ensure the WHT_Calculation workbook shows the base taxable items, rate applied (10%), and final net due. Also include GL codes for accounting.

Vivek — can you send the wiring template and confirmation whether we should use Redwood's short-term escrow account or advise Greenleaf to hold on their side?

Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

--- Message 4: Jordan (external) final ack and request for DocuSign / escrow instructions ---
From: Jordan Price <accounts-payable@greenleaf.health>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenleaf Procurement <procure@greenleaf.health>, Elena Morris <elena.morris@greenleaf.health>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final billing items before renewal effective 2027-04-30

Maya — that timeline works. We got the draft invoice and the excel calc in your earlier message (thank you). Two quick asks: 
1) Please send the DocuSign if you plan to add a 30-day holdback amendment to the contract so our Procurement and Legal can sign before payment release.
2) If Redwood will accept withholding (no gross-up), please attach the completed withholding-certificate (or instructions for our tax team to complete it) so we can file the WHT on our side.

We will plan payment upon receipt of the final packet and a signed amendment (if applicable).

Thanks,
Jordan
Accounts Payable | Greenleaf Health

--- End of thread ---
